svg.text: The change, and the record of it, side by side
0056–0057 — day 51 — §4b step 4. A public demo at /demo, running §1–§6 against a page nobody wrote to pass a test.
ONE SCREEN, TWO HALVES — NEITHER IS INTERESTING WITHOUT THE OTHER
the page — a LoomTree, rendered
hero · logo-cloud · feature-grid · stat-grid
quote · faq-list · section · divider · action
Not a screenshot, a video or a mock. 12 of the
18 registered primitives, resolved per request.
0 lines of markup. 0 render diagnostics.
the record — the runtime's own narration
rationale · interpreter · authoredBy · confidence · delta
stakes level + every factor · reversible + inverse
decision · rule · policy + fingerprint · revision
A pure projection of the RuntimeEvent stream, so a
surface cannot show a verdict the Gate did not reach.
Every field already existed. What was missing was the surface.
0057 — A DEMONSTRATED CHANGE IS A DETERMINISTIC INTERPRETER, NOT A SCRIPT BESIDE THE RUNTIME
five chips
plan(tree) → operations
authoredBy: runtime
no key needed
free text
the model, when there is one
authoredBy: model
the same pipeline, and nothing downstream can tell which one authored the proposal
assessChange
two axes
gate
policy: demo
apply / hold
a person answers
append · revision · inverse
undo is a proposal, not a rewind
re-theme → low stakes → accepted, within-policy → revision 1
insert → medium stakes → requires-confirmation → waits for the visitor
undo of a contested revision → discards-later-work → held, per 0035
0056 — THE DEMO IS PUBLIC, AND SHARES NOTHING WITH THE PORTAL BUT THE DEPLOYMENT
/demo — no session, no identity
its own registry — the starter library
its own store — memory, per visitor, per instance
its own policy — named "demo"
no journal — the record never leaves the request
A visitor's page resets when the instance recycles.
Correct for a demo; data loss for a portal — which is
the clearest statement of how little the two share.
what keeps the exemption honest
guarded-pages.test.ts names all three unguarded pages
and reads their source for @/lib/store, /write,
/telemetry, /database — auth excepted, sign-in needs it
The danger was never the door. It is the next
unguarded page reaching through it for a store
handle, which looks exactly like an ordinary import.
Free text is bounded: a token bucket per session and per instance.
pnpm verify green — 1121 runtime tests, 429 portal tests (46 new), 0 failed, 0 skipped.
Next: §4c, the documentation site — MDX prose, and every example a real tree with a propose box.
